rows.question: Identify a list of genes expressed in lung cancer
rows.pred_sql:
WITH gene_symbol_ensembl_lookup AS (
  SELECT
    x.gene_symbol AS gene_symbol,
    x.ensembl_gene_id AS ensembl_gene_id,
    x.speciesid AS speciesid
  FROM xref_gene_ensembl x
  WHERE x.ensembl_gene_id IS NOT NULL
    AND x.ensembl_gene_id <> ''
),
healthy_expression_by_uberon_gene AS (
  SELECT
    ensembl_gene_id,
    uberon_anatomical_id,
    uberon_developmental_id,
    expression_level_gene_relative,
    expression_level_anatomical_relative,
    expression_score,
    expression_rank_score,
    call_quality
  FROM healthy_expression
),
cancer_tissue_by_uberon AS (
  SELECT
    ct.doid AS doid,
    ct.uberon_anatomical_id AS uberon_anatomical_id
  FROM cancer_tissue ct
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(gsl.gene_symbol, NULL) AS gene_symbol,
  he.ensembl_gene_id,
  he.expression_level_gene_relative,
  ct.uberon_anatomical_id
FROM cancer_tissue_by_uberon ct
JOIN healthy_expression_by_uberon_gene he
  ON he.uberon_anatomical_id = ct.uberon_anatomical_id
LEFT JOIN gene_symbol_ensembl_lookup gsl
  ON gsl.ensembl_gene_id = he.ensembl_gene_id
WHERE ct.uberon_anatomical_id = 'UBERON:0002048'
  AND he.expression_level_gene_relative IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY gene_symbol NULLS LAST, he.ensembl_gene_id

rows.question: Get the biomarker gene symbol and biomarker description for disease with name 'breast cancer'
rows.pred_sql:
WITH disease_core AS (
  SELECT
    d.id AS id,
    d.name AS name
  FROM disease d
  WHERE d.name = 'breast cancer'
),
biomarker_core AS (
  SELECT
    b.id AS id,
    b.gene_symbol AS gene_symbol,
    b.biomarker_description AS biomarker_description,
    b.biomarker_id AS biomarker_id,
    b.test_is_a_panel AS test_is_a_panel
  FROM biomarker b
)
/* Schema contains no explicit table linking biomarker -> disease.
   Per instructions, when no direct association exists, return all biomarkers.
   Keep disease_core in CTE to preserve the intent/filter if a link existed. */
SELECT
  b.gene_symbol,
  b.biomarker_description
FROM biomarker_core b
-- ensure disease exists; cross join acts as no-op filter when disease present
CROSS JOIN disease_core d
ORDER BY b.gene_symbol
